repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-mercury
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin that keeps the client's Mercury WebSocket connections open. It registers webex.internal.mercury, connects one socket per session id after device registration, authorizes and keeps each socket alive with ping/pong, reconnects with exponential backoff according to close codes, routes incoming envelopes to autowired plugin handlers and to session-suffixed events, and switches sockets make-before-break when the server announces shutdown.

negative_guidance.why: A lower layer can rewrite the native URL to a non-catalog host; reconnects use sessionWebSocketUrls.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change a close-code branch without updating the close-code table in test/unit/spec/mercury-events.js.
negative_guidance.why: The table is the only test of the full reconnect policy.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not put the access token in the URL or a log line.
negative_guidance.why: The token is meant to be sent over the network only in the authorization frame.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change only one of src/socket/socket.js and src/socket/socket.shim.js.
negative_guidance.why: package.json browser swaps them at build time, so divergence is invisible on the platform you test.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the list of config keys or events.
negative_guidance.why: It omits pingInterval, pongTimeout, forceCloseDelay, beforeLogoutOptionsCloseReason, and the shutdown events. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy-tools Mocha runner has no coverage.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example the forced-close reconnect, switchover socket bookkeeping, or the platform hooks. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
